name: main-menu-visual
description: Visual verification of the main menu: title and subtitle display, menu buttons (New Campaign, Tutorial, Continue, Load, Settings) as they first render before any game state exists, New Campaign greyed out with its Coming soon badge (#2276), and then the in-game HUD after a level is started.

steps.description: Initial load: page has not run any command yet, so the main menu overlay (title, subtitle, and all 5 buttons) is the only thing on screen. 'help' is a read-only console command that does not touch game state or the DOM, used here purely so the step has a harmless command to pair with the screenshot.

expect.note: New Campaign renders greyed with a Coming soon badge (#2276); Sandbox stays usable

steps.description: #2276: New Campaign is closed: the button is disabled and carries the Coming soon badge, so no click can reach the world map; the menu stays the live surface. `state` is the paired command for this UI-only step (issue #585).

expect.note: no world map replaced the menu

steps.description: #1323: gameplay hotkeys are inert while the main menu is up. A player presses Space (pause), KeyB (blast panel) and F5 (quick save) on the bare menu: none may act, so the menu stays on screen and no blast panel opens. 'state' is the paired command for this UI-only step; no game exists yet so the console outcome is genuinely either (same as the neighbouring steps, issue #585). isPaused cannot be asserted here because no game state exists before new_game; the unit tests in tests/unit/ui/KeyboardShortcuts.test.ts cover the callback-level guarantee.

expect.note: the main menu is still the live surface and the B hotkey did not open the blast panel behind it
confirmed via direct trace: cash stays flat with no employees/buildings/vehicles to drain it

steps.description: Resolved through the event dialog's own buttons. Decides whether an event is pending from authoritative game state, not from whether the modal has rendered -- a DOM-only probe silently missed events on a no-GPU runner where a frame costs ~6s, leaving them pending so later ticks halted and the run diverged while still passing command mode.
